sloka: स ताम् समीक्ष्य एव हरि ईश पत्नीम्तस्थौ उदासीनतया महात्मा ।अवाङ्मुखो आभूत् मनुजेन्द्र पुत्रःस्त्री सन्निकर्षात् विनिवृत्त कोपम् ॥४-३३-३९॥
transliteration: sa tām samīkṣya eva hari īśa patnīmtasthau udāsīnatayā mahātmā ।avāṅmukho ābhūt manujendra putraḥstrī sannikarṣāt vinivṛtta kopam ॥4-33-39॥

translations.english: Since prince Lakshmana is a great man, he stood with his face down and showing no reaction, controlled his anger due to the presence of a female standing close by.
